newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Parliament postpones debate on excise duties.
newsitem.headline: Parliament postpones debate on excise duties.

text.p: The European Parliament postponed a debate on Thursday on a European Commission report on excise duties on tobacco, alcohol and mineral oils.
The debate is now expected to take place at the plenary session in Strasbourg on September 16-20.

Alan Donnelly, the Socialist spokesman for the economic and monetary affairs committee, told Reuters the committee intended to produce a report which dealt with broad principles rather than specific excise duty rates.

These included whether duties on wines, beers and spirits should be based on their alcohol content; whether health should be a consideration in setting excise rates especially on tobacco; and how to prevent market distortion in cross border trade because of different rates.
